Definition: to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tie, bind, imprison; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tie, bind; 1a2) to tie, harness; 1a3) to bind (with cords); 1a4) to gird (rare and late); 1a5) to begin the battle, make the attack; 1a6) of obligation of oath (figurative); 1b) (Niphal) to be imprisoned, bound; 1c) (Pual) to be taken prisoner
